Sam Altman is the CEO of OpenAI.[S1][S10]  

OpenAI does **not** provide a public home address or personal phone number for the CEO in the evidence provided, so I can’t establish those details.[S1][S10]  

For publicly listed contact channels, the evidence indicates OpenAI provides:
- **Press inquiries:** `press@openai.com`.[S6][S7][S12]  
- **General support/inquiries:** `support@openai.com`.[S6][S7][S14]  
- **Support access method:** use the live chat widget at `help.openai.com` (and the sources indicate there is **no phone support**).[S14][S18][S12]  

The evidence does not establish any public executive-office email/phone specifically for the CEO personally beyond the general press/support channels above.[S6][S7][S14]
